sentences.en: Some machines produced at this time may have phono plugs for audio, plus a special ' locking ' BNC connector for video.

sentences.en: Even if they do, a separate phono preamp can often help you achieve higher fidelity replay from your vinyl.

sentences.en: The BCD2000 is packed with 2 state-of-the-art phono preamplifiers, one of which is switchable to a CD player.

sentences.en: Devices can be attached either via the three phono sockets or an S-Video Port.

sentences.en: To connect to a domestic television use the phono to co-axial connecting lead supplied.
sentences.vi: Để kết nối với TV trong nước, hãy sử dụng phono với dây dẫn kết nối đồng trục được cung cấp.

sentences.en: If you have the retail card, you will need a phono to minijack adapter for the audio.

sentences.en: A separate phono plug to phono plug to phono plug lead can then used to connect to the control box.

sentences.en: Connectivity on the receiver is offered either via a 3.5mm phono jack or a pair of standard phono jack or a pair of standard phono cables.
